subject.title: fix(kill-tree): verify process group leader before using group kill to prevent gateway SIGTERM (#76259)

question: Should OpenClaw accept the shared Unix kill-tree default change from unconditional omitted-option group kill to leader-checked group kill with explicit detached-owner opt-ins?
rationale: The patch looks correct, but it deliberately changes a shared exported helper behavior and the remaining choice is maintainer acceptance of the compatibility and cleanup-availability tradeoff.

options.title: Accept the helper-side invariant
options.body: Merge after required checks if maintainers agree that preventing gateway self-SIGTERM is worth the safer single-PID fallback for omitted callers without leader proof.

options.title: Ask for one more live launchd proof
options.body: Request a current-head macOS launchd or Crabbox-style process cleanup run before merge if maintainers want more confidence in the exact managed-gateway scenario.

options.title: Rework to caller-only cleanup state
options.body: Pause or replace the PR if maintainers prefer avoiding a shared helper default change, accepting that earlier caller-only coverage left omitted callers risky.

recommendation.title: Accept the helper-side invariant
recommendation.body: Merge after required checks if maintainers agree that preventing gateway self-SIGTERM is worth the safer single-PID fallback for omitted callers without leader proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main helper ownership and process-area maintenance make this the best available routing owner for the shared helper default choice.
